--CHANGE D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_<DATE> ACCORDINGLY WITH THE DEPLOYMENT DATE

IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_20250423' and table_schema = 'D360') 
	BEGIN
		DROP TABLE D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_20250423;
	END;

CREATE TABLE D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_20250423
WITH
(
	HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT 
	*
FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION;

--CHANGE D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_<DATE> ACCORDINGLY WITH THE DEPLOYMENT DATE

SELECT 'TARGET' [TABLE_NAME], COUNT(1) REC_CNT FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TARGET' [TABLE_NAME], COUNT(1) REC_CNT FROM D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_20250423;

--CHANGE D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_<DATE> ACCORDINGLY WITH THE DEPLOYMENT DATE

WITH TEMP AS (
    SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID
	, BR_CD
	, BASE_NO
	, LAST6_BASE_NO
	, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
	, PRODUCT_ID
	, PURPOSE
	, INCEPTION_DATE
	, MARKETING_OFFICER
	, STATUS
	, PAYMENT_TYPE
	, RC_DIVISION
	, REFERRED_BY
	, REVIEW_DATE
	, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
	, TBG_REFERRAL
	, FEE_SERVICE
	, MAKER_ID
	, MAKER_DATE
	, AUTH_ID
	, AUTH_DATE
	, REJECT_REASON
	, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
	, TRUST_AGMT_INT
	, MANDATE
	, IS_BLACKLISTED
	, BLACKLISTED_DATE
	, CAST(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS SCD_START_DATE
	, COALESCE(DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day, CAST('99991231' AS DATE)) AS SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, CASE WHEN DATE_DIM.Previous_Business_Day is null then 1 else 0 end as ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, INSERT_DTTM

FROM
(
	SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID
		, BR_CD
		, BASE_NO
		, LAST6_BASE_NO
		, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
		, PRODUCT_ID
		, PURPOSE
		, INCEPTION_DATE
		, MARKETING_OFFICER
		, STATUS
		, PAYMENT_TYPE
		, RC_DIVISION
		, REFERRED_BY
		, REVIEW_DATE
		, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
		, TBG_REFERRAL
		, FEE_SERVICE
		, MAKER_ID
		, MAKER_DATE
		, AUTH_ID
		, AUTH_DATE
		, REJECT_REASON
		, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
		, TRUST_AGMT_INT
		, MANDATE
		, IS_BLACKLISTED
		, BLACKLISTED_DATE
		, ISACTIVE
		, ISLATEST
		, BNK_CODE
		, SOURCE_CODE
		, FILE_NAME
		, INSERT_DTTM

		, Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) START_DATE     
		, Max(Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) Over (PARTITION BY SUBSCRIPTION_ID, BASE_NO
			ORDER BY Left(Right(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) ROWS BETWEEN 1 Following AND 1 Following) END_DATE                  				
	FROM
	(
		SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID
			, BR_CD
			, BASE_NO
			, LAST6_BASE_NO
			, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
			, PRODUCT_ID
			, PURPOSE
			, INCEPTION_DATE
			, MARKETING_OFFICER
			, STATUS
			, PAYMENT_TYPE
			, RC_DIVISION
			, REFERRED_BY
			, REVIEW_DATE
			, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
			, TBG_REFERRAL
			, FEE_SERVICE
			, MAKER_ID
			, MAKER_DATE
			, AUTH_ID
			, AUTH_DATE
			, REJECT_REASON
			, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
			, TRUST_AGMT_INT
			, MANDATE
			, IS_BLACKLISTED
			, BLACKLISTED_DATE
			, ISACTIVE
			, ISLATEST
			, BNK_CODE
			, SOURCE_CODE
			, FILE_NAME
			, INSERT_DTTM
			, row_number() 
				over( partition by SUBSCRIPTION_ID
						, BR_CD
						, BASE_NO
						, LAST6_BASE_NO
						, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
						, PRODUCT_ID
						, PURPOSE
						, INCEPTION_DATE
						, MARKETING_OFFICER
						, STATUS
						, PAYMENT_TYPE
						, RC_DIVISION
						, REFERRED_BY
						, REVIEW_DATE
						, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
						, TBG_REFERRAL
						, FEE_SERVICE
						, MAKER_ID
						, MAKER_DATE
						, AUTH_ID
						, AUTH_DATE
						, REJECT_REASON
						, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
						, TRUST_AGMT_INT
						, MANDATE
						, IS_BLACKLISTED
						, BLACKLISTED_DATE
						--, ISACTIVE
						--, ISLATEST
						, BNK_CODE
						, SOURCE_CODE
						, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME,12),8)
					order by insert_dttm DESC) AS SEQ_NO
		FROM D360.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION_BU_20250423

	) AS TMP
	WHERE SEQ_NO = 1
) AS SCDT2
LEFT JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM
	ON CAST(END_DATE AS INTEGER) = DATE_DIM.DATESK
)

INSERT INTO 
EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION
(
	  SUBSCRIPTION_ID
	, BR_CD
	, BASE_NO
	, LAST6_BASE_NO
	, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
	, PRODUCT_ID
	, PURPOSE
	, INCEPTION_DATE
	, MARKETING_OFFICER
	, STATUS
	, PAYMENT_TYPE
	, RC_DIVISION
	, REFERRED_BY
	, REVIEW_DATE
	, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
	, TBG_REFERRAL
	, FEE_SERVICE
	, MAKER_ID
	, MAKER_DATE
	, AUTH_ID
	, AUTH_DATE
	, REJECT_REASON
	, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
	, TRUST_AGMT_INT
	, MANDATE
	, IS_BLACKLISTED
	, BLACKLISTED_DATE
	, SCD_START_DATE
	, SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, INSERT_DTTM
)
SELECT 
	  SUBSCRIPTION_ID
	, BR_CD
	, BASE_NO
	, LAST6_BASE_NO
	, SUBSCRIPTION_NAME
	, PRODUCT_ID
	, PURPOSE
	, INCEPTION_DATE
	, MARKETING_OFFICER
	, STATUS
	, PAYMENT_TYPE
	, RC_DIVISION
	, REFERRED_BY
	, REVIEW_DATE
	, DISPOSITIVE_PROVISION
	, TBG_REFERRAL
	, FEE_SERVICE
	, MAKER_ID
	, MAKER_DATE
	, AUTH_ID
	, AUTH_DATE
	, REJECT_REASON
	, TRUST_AGMT_EXT
	, TRUST_AGMT_INT
	, MANDATE
	, IS_BLACKLISTED
	, BLACKLISTED_DATE
	, SCD_START_DATE
	, SCD_END_DATE
	, ISACTIVE
	, ISLATEST
	, BNK_CODE
	, SOURCE_CODE
	, FILE_NAME
	, INSERT_DTTM
FROM 
	TEMP

WITH TMP AS(
    SELECT DISTINCT SUBSCRIPTION_ID, BASE_NO FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION
)
SELECT 'DISTINCT_RECORDS' [RECORD_TYPE], COUNT(1) RECROD_CNT FROM TMP
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ACTIVE_RECORDS', COUNT(1) FROM EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION
WHERE ISLATEST = 1;
